create_XFPSolver: create an XFPSolver instance for extensive-form fictitious play on a given game
run_XFP_iterations: run fictitious play iterations to compute best responses and update average policies
sample_XFP_episodes: sample episodes from a set of policies and return average utility estimates
get_XFP_metagame: get an empirical meta-game tensor from saved oracles via Monte Carlo simulation
create_JointPolicy: create a JointPolicy wrapping per-player policies into a single callable policy for all players
